scripts.build: node copy-icons.js && tsc && vite build && node build-extension-scripts.js
scripts.build:staging: node copy-icons.js && tsc && vite build --mode staging && MODE=staging node build-extension-scripts.js && node scripts/patch-manifest-beta.js
scripts.build:staging:zip: npm run build:staging && rm -f waillet-chrome-staging.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../waillet-chrome-staging.zip .
scripts.build:production: node copy-icons.js && tsc && vite build --mode production && node build-extension-scripts.js
scripts.build:production:zip: npm run build:production && rm -f waillet-chrome.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../waillet-chrome.zip .
scripts.build:firefox:production:zip: npm run build:firefox:production && rm -f waillet-firefox.zip && cd dist-firefox && zip -r ../waillet-firefox.zip .
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx web-ext run --source-dir=./dist-firefox --firefox=firefox
scripts.dev:firefox:nightly: npm run build:firefox && npx web-ext run --source-dir=./dist-firefox --firefox=nightly
scripts.dev:firefox:production: npm run build:firefox:production && npx web-ext run --source-dir=./dist-firefox --firefox=firefox
scripts.dev:chrome:production: npm run build:production && echo '' && echo '✅ Chrome build ready at ./dist' && echo '   Load it in Chrome: chrome://extensions → Enable Developer mode → Load unpacked → select dist/'
